messages:
emma: Quick heads-up — co-hosted live-coding with AcmeHW on 2025-04-06 10:00 PDT. Need final speaker commits, hardware/demo fallback plan, and kit shipping confirmation. Drive + assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFG (please don't redistribute).
jordan: Got it. Who's confirmed as speakers? Also what's the expected audience size?
emma: Confirmed: Emma (Redwood AM), Lee (AcmeHW Senior Eng), Simon (Redwood Field SE). Nora (Marketing) is MC. Expected ~200 live attendees, streaming to YouTube.
simon: Demo kit shipped — FedEx tracking 1Z999AA10123456789. ETA 2025-04-04 18:00 PST. Contents: 1x EdgeBox, 1x power kit, 1x USB key with demo assets.
lee: I'll bring a second EdgeBox from our side as a backup. Partner contact on site: Michael H. <michael@acmehw.com> +1-415-555-0123.
emma: Great — can someone confirm serials so ops can register them in inventory?
simon: Shipping manifest includes serial: EB-889-AC-21. I've added manifest to the Drive folder.
jordan: Run-of-show draft? We should lock timings to coordinate A/V.
emma: Run-of-show (short):
```
10:00 - Welcome + intros (5m)
10:05 - Product overview (5m)
10:10 - Live coding: integrate EdgeBox w/ Redwood Dedicated (Lee) (20m)
10:30 - Failover demo: hardware -> hosted fallback (Simon) (10m)
10:40 - Live Q&A (10m)
10:50 - Close + CTA (10m)
```
nora: I'll create the speaker slide deck template and the social copy. Need headshots + 1-paragraph bios by 2025-03-26.
lee: For the failover demo, backup plan is: if hardware stalls, switch to hosted endpoint in us-west-2 using model tag rdx-7b-quant -> rdx-7b-fp16 as second fallback. I can script the toggle.
emma: Perfect. Simon, can you validate network env at venue supports outbound TLS to Redwood endpoints (443)?
simon: Venue network contact: venue-net@conferencesvc.com. I'll run a preflight 24h before show. Also scheduling A/V dry-run on 2025-04-05 16:00 PDT.
jordan: Who's running the stream? Need RTMP key and a rehearsal link.
nora: Marketing will own the YouTube stream. Nora -> I'll need stream key from Events. Jordan, can you generate & drop link in this thread?
jordan: Yep. I created a preview stream: https://studio.youtube.com/preview/abc123 — RTMP key shared in the drive (permissions: partnerships@redwood.com, acmehw@michael).
emma: Checklist for on-site techs (short):
- Confirm EdgeBox powered on + firmware v2.3.1
- Confirm power adapters and spare cables
- Confirm SSH access to device and API keys present in /etc/redwood/demo.key
- Confirm fallback host reachable: rdx-hosted.us-west-2.redwood.internal:443
- Test latency with `curl -s https://rdx-hosted.us-west-2/redwood/ping`
Simon will do the preflight.
simon: Added the small script to Drive (preflight.sh). Will run 1x week before and again 24h before.
lee: Small ask from AcmeHW: can we reserve a 6-foot table and 1 monitor for local demo? Also need 1x HDMI->USB capture.
emma: Yes — requested to venue (ticket #V-4521).
nora: Swag note: AcmeHW provided stickers and 50 mini power banks. I requested that ops drop them at registration. Can someone confirm courier cutoffs?
simon: Courier cutoff is Apr 3 14:00 PST for on-site pickup. If anything arrives after that, venue charges a $95/day handling fee.
lee: If the EdgeBox shows a sensor fault, plan B is switching to recorded transcript + hosted replay. Scripted toggle command: `POST /v1/switch-demo {"target":"hosted","model":"rdx-7b-quant"}` — Simon pls validate CLI works in offline mode.
simon: Validated the toggle command locally. Will add a timeout and automatic retry to the runbook.
emma: Marketing assets: can you produce 1 slide with 3 bullet points on business value (latency, cost, reliability) and an optional CI benchmark chart?
nora: On it. Also prepping a 1-page integration playbook for partner handout. Need logos and product descriptions in SVG by EOD Friday.
lee: Sent logos in SVG to the Drive.
jordan: Reminder — we need a canned message for MC in case the live demo fails. Nora, can you draft two options (light tone + fallback technical) pls?
nora: Drafted both copies and added to Drive under /scripts/mc_fallback.txt.
emma: Outstanding actions: 1) Speakers to send bios by 2025-03-26 (ALL), 2) Ops to confirm FedEx delivered + serial registration (Simon), 3) A/V dry-run 2025-04-05 16:00 PDT (Jordan), 4) Marketing assets + MC scripts (Nora), 5) Partner on-site contact confirmed (Lee).
lee: I'll ping Michael to confirm arrival window and point who'll set up with venue.
simon: Confirmed: FedEx delivery ETA met, I will update inventory and tag serial EB-889-AC-21.
deploy-bot: @emma preview stream created and scheduled (preview link: https://studio.youtube.com/preview/abc123).
emma: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, drop it here or DM. :thumbsup:
jordan: :thumbsup:
